text: Why do families honour a little girl as the Devi?
Kumari puja is the Navaratri tradition of honouring young girls as forms of the Devi.
Remembering that the Devi's shakti lives in every girl, families place a bottu (tilak) on her forehead, offer flowers and prasadam, and honour her with a small gift.
Only if it is your family's custom — and only if she is happy to.
